Suspension Strut Mount Kit

The suspension shock mount is a component that secures the shock absorber to the vehicle's chassis or body. It helps connect the shock absorber to the vehicle while allowing for the necessary movement and cushioning of the suspension system. The shock mount is typically made of metal and rubber, providing both strength and flexibility to absorb vibrations and shocks from the road.

Suspension Strut Mount Kit Failure Symptoms

  • Clunking or Banging Noises: A worn or damaged shock mount can cause clunking, knocking, or banging noises, especially when driving over bumps, potholes, or rough roads. These sounds occur because the shock absorber is not properly secured to the vehicle, allowing it to move or rattle.
  • Increased Body Roll or Bouncing: A failing shock mount can prevent the shock absorber from doing its job correctly, leading to excessive body roll when cornering or increased bouncing when driving over bumps.

[Option 1] S-FLO Carbon Inlet Tube:

The S-FLO Carbon Inlet Tube is the largest amongst its peers, with impressive adaptability to facilitate maximum gains. The colossal 4.5” S-FLO Carbon Inlet tube bridges the gap between the turbo inlet pipe and the factory airbox seamlessly.

The S-FLO Carbon Inlet Tube is for drivers looking to extract the most out of their factory airbox while increasing throttle response.

[Option 2] S-FLO Shortie Carbon Intake:

The S-FLO Shortie Carbon Intakes replaces the factory airbox with a massive S-FLO Filter with frontal opening toting a 30% increase in filter surface area, and a 4.5” carbon elbow. All firmly planted via a bespoke CNC laser-cut stainless support bracket.

The S-FLO Shortie Carbon Intake is the perfect configuration for drivers looking to uncork beloved turbo noises out of their RS 3.

Combine the S-FLO Carbon Inlet Tube with the Shortie Carbon Intake, and you have the impressive (and very vocal) S-FLO Open Carbon Intake System.

The S-FLO Closed Carbon Intake System unlocks 17 hp and 6 ft-lbs of torque at the wheels, and is capable of handling any higher-than-stock boost level thrown at it.

products.body_html:
HIGHLIGHTS 

• Gain up to 41whp / 45wtq

• 1-Piece Design with Integrated Midpipe Flanges
• Pre-Installed Midpipe Flange Bolts for Faster Installation

PROFILE

The ARM C8 RS6/RS7 1-Piece Downpipes are an evolution of the original ARM C8 downpipe design, engineered for enthusiasts who want a cleaner, faster installation without sacrificing performance. By integrating the midpipe flanges directly into the main downpipe body and pre-installing the flange bolts, this kit eliminates the separate midpipe flange assembly step and significantly reduces installation time. Available with optional heat shielding to contain exhaust heat within the downpipe and protect surrounding components. Built from 304 stainless steel with a 5.75" CNC machined V-band flange for a precise turbo connection. Fits C8 RS6, RS7, and D5 S8/A8 4.0T.

The ARM C8 RS6/RS7 1-Piece Downpipes improve exhaust flow on 4.0T-powered C8 RS6, RS7, and D5 S8/A8 models. By reducing backpressure, the ARM downpipes allow the 4.0T turbos to spool faster, delivering stronger power and torque output, especially in the lower RPM range, along with a more aggressive exhaust note. This updated 1-piece design retains all the performance of the original ARM C8 downpipes while streamlining the installation process with a fully integrated midpipe flange and pre-installed hardware.  


The OEM C8 RS6/RS7 downpipes incorporate two large catalysts which restrict exhaust flow and power from your Audi C8 RS6/RS7.  By upgrading your OEM RS6/RS7 downpipes with the ARM C8 RS6/RS7 downpipes you will eliminate this restriction and improve exhaust flow, increasing power and torque. The ARM C8 1-Piece Downpipes were dyno tested on our own C8 RS6, confirming up to 35whp over the OEM downpipes.



 

CONSTRUCTION

 The ARM C8 RS6/RS7 Downpipes are built from SS304 stainless steel to ensure bulletproof build strength and weld integrity for the life of your Audi RS6/RS7.  You will never need another set of downpipes again!  The ARM C8 RS Downpipes start at the turbochargers with a 5.75" CNC machined V-Band flange.  This flange allows the ARM RS Downpipes to connect to the OEM turbos, or upgraded turbos that use the same size exhaust side housings. 



The ARM RS6 Downpipes maintain a full 304 Stainless Steel 5.5" body all the way until where the design turns downwards towards the midpipes, where they gradually reduce down to 3" in order to connect with the ARM C8 4.0T Midpipes, or OEM Midpipes. 




The original ARM C8 downpipes feature removable midpipe flanges supplied as separate components. The 1-Piece design integrates these flanges directly into the downpipe body with bolts pre-installed,reducing the number of steps during installation and the need to handle more loose hardware under the vehicle.


The ARM C8 RS6/RS7 Downpipes are now available with an optional Thermal Shielding upgrade. The thermal shields wrap the downpipe body to contain exhaust heat, preventing it from radiating into the surrounding engine bay and undercarriage. Keeping heat contained within the downpipe also helps maintain exhaust gas temperature, hotter gases are less dense and move through the system faster, which supports stronger exhaust scavenging and more consistent performance under sustained driving. For builds running aggressive tunes or track use, Thermal Shielding reduces the thermal load on nearby wiring, hoses, and chassis components. Select the Thermal Shielding option at checkout to include it with your kit.

Built from 304 stainless steel for long-term durability and weld integrity. Key features include:
• 5.75" CNC machined V-band flange for precise turbo alignment
• Full 304 SS body tapering from 5.5" to 3" for midpipe connection
• Integrated midpipe flanges machined directly into the main downpipe body, no separate flange assembly required
• Pre-installed midpipe flange bolts for a faster, more straightforward installation
• Optional Thermal Shielding to contain exhaust heat within the downpipe and reduce thermal load on surrounding components

THE EXHAUST:

The AWE Exhaust Suite for the 2025+ BMW 330i and 430i delivers a new level of sound and performance to BMW's turbocharged four-cylinder platform. Available as the sophisticated Touring Edition or aggressive Track Edition, each configuration is engineered specifically for sedan and coupe applications.

Crafted from CNC mandrel-bent 3” U.S.-sourced .065”-wall T304L stainless steel, both catback configurations feature a resonated mid pipe and a clean, straight-through design engineered to maximize performance and deliver a rich, responsive exhaust note.

Both editions feature an integrated valve simulator bracket for seamless accommodation of the factory valve electronics, and are finished with dual 4.5” tips in your choice of chrome silver or diamond black.

 

TOURING EDITION:

Refinement meets attitude. The Touring Edition features AWE's patented drone-canceling 180 Technology®, delivering a deep, sophisticated exhaust note that comes alive under throttle while maintaining maximum comfort on the highway.

At the heart of the Touring Edition is AWE's patented 180 Technology®, which targets and cancels problematic frequencies that cause unwanted in-cabin drone. By controlling the timing of reflected sound waves as they rejoin the main exhaust flow, 180 Technology® creates a 180-degree out-of-phase sound wave that cancels these frequencies without restricting exhaust flow. The result is an engaging exhaust note when you want it, and refined cruising when you don't.

Weighing in at 46.5 lbs, the Touring Edition sheds 4.5 lbs compared to the factory exhaust.

 

TRACK EDITION:

For those who prefer their soundtrack with a little less restraint, there's the Track Edition.

The Track Edition trades the Touring Edition's 180 Technology® for a more aggressive, pronounced exhaust note. Featuring a resonated mid pipe and an unrestricted straight-through configuration, the Track Edition puts the turbocharged four-cylinder's character front and center, delivering maximum attitude throughout the rev range.

At just 35 lbs, the Track Edition drops 16 lbs compared to the factory exhaust, making it the lightest and most aggressive configuration in the suite.

NEVER STUCK WITH AWE CONVERSION KITS:

LET'S TALK TIPS:

Both Touring and Track Editions are finished with dual 4.5” slash-cut tips, available in chrome silver or diamond black. Designed to complement the BMW's factory rear styling, each finish delivers a clean, purposeful look to match the soundtrack.

 

POWER TO THE PAVEMENT:

The AWE Exhaust Suite unlocks dyno-verified max gains of +4 hp and +5 lb-ft of torque at the wheels on stock software.

 

100% EMISSION-FRIENDLY:

AWE Exhausts do not interfere with any factory emissions equipment.

 

MADE IN PA, USA:

Engineered, designed, and manufactured in-house at AWE using US-sourced .065”-wall T304L stainless steel to achieve a tone deeper than everyone else.

B58 Complete Fuel Injector Refresh & Hardware Kit

Restore smooth power delivery and precise high-pressure fueling to your turbocharged BMW. Tailored for B58-powered G-Series, and F-Series platforms, this kit pairs factory-grade replacement injectors with all the essential single-use hardware required for a safe, leak-free installation.

Kit Contents:

  • 6x Bosch High-Pressure Fuel Injectors (Bosch #0261500437 / OE BMW #13538656548)

  • 12x Fuel Injector Retaining Bracket Screws (OE BMW #13538661716)

  • 8x Fuel Injection Rail Bolts (OE BMW #13538661715)

  • 2x High-Pressure Fuel Pump Mounting Bolts (OE BMW #13517632572)

Understanding B58 Direct Injection

Modern BMW power plants rely on Direct Injection (DI) to atomize fuel directly within the combustion chamber under extreme pressure, rather than spraying into the intake manifold like traditional port-injection systems. Because of these high operating pressures, proper fuel delivery is paramount. When factory injectors wear out or clog over time, spray patterns degrade, leading to poor combustion efficiency and power loss.

Signs of Injector Failure

If one or more fuel injectors begin sticking open, leaking, or clogging, you may experience:

  • Power Drop & Poor Acceleration: Inconsistent fuel flow under load, resulting in sluggish throttle response, hesitation, and difficulty maintaining steady speed.

  • Rough, Unstable Idling: Cylinder delivery imbalances that cause excessive engine vibration and erratic idling while stopped.

  • Increased Fuel Usage: Sticking or leaking injectors that over-feed the cylinders, significantly reducing fuel economy.

  • Engine Misfires & Check Engine Light: Misfires accompanied by severe hesitation, potential stalling, and active fault codes stored in your DME.
